text:
I traveled from the United States to Thailand specifically to have a breast augmentation procedure done at Surapol Cosmetic Clinic, trusting its reputation and high ratings.
What I experienced instead was deeply upsetting, humiliating, and, in my view, rooted in racial discrimination because of the color of my skin.
From the moment I arrived for my
consultation and later my scheduled surgery on March 18, I felt a clear shift in how I was treated. One of the nurses was cold, dismissive, and unwelcoming. When I politely checked in for my appointment, I was abruptly told to "just sit down," with no courtesy or professionalism. It immediately made me uncomfortable, but I tried to ignore it and move forward in good faith.
On the day of surgery, my blood pressure was elevated due to understandable nerves
—something that can happen to anyone, especially before a medical procedure. I am otherwise in good health with no history of high blood pressure. The doctor himself was kind and made several attempts to proceed,
but ultimately we agreed to reschedule.
Before I left, he gave me clear instructions: to take prescribed medication to stabilize my blood pressure and return so we could move forward with the surgery.
I followed his instructions exactly. I obtained the medication, took it as directed, and returned with proof that my blood pressure was now within a safe, normal range for surgery. However, when I came back, the doctor's wife-who appeared to be in a position of authority-refused to schedule me for another appointment. This directly contradicted the doctor's explicit instructions.
When I calmly explained that I had followed every step her husband outlined and that I was now medically cleared, she still refused.
I asked if I could speak directly with the doctor to clarify the situation, and she denied me that opportunity as well. At that point, I asked her directly what the issue was and whether I was being treated differently because of the color of my skin.
She offered no response-only silence and dismissal-and just looked at me and laughed.

In that moment, I felt completely disrespected, devalued, and humiliated. I came across the world in good faith for a professional medical service and was instead met with treatment that felt discriminatory and unjust. There was no valid medical reason provided, no transparency, and no willingness to communicate-only exclusion.
This experience was not just disappointing; it was deeply hurtful. No one should ever be made to feel less than or denied fair treatment because of their race. We all deserve dignity, respect, and equal care-especially in a medical setting where trust and professionalism should be the Foundation.  With this Experience I would not recommend Surapol Cosmetics Surgery Clinic. 1 ⭐️
